name: Lazy Weeknight Dinners
instructions: Build the meal around one starch (pasta, rice, or frozen dumplings) that cooks directly in the sauce or broth -- one less pot to watch.
Use pre-chopped, frozen, or canned vegetables on nights you are too tired to prep from scratch; they are still real food.
Stir in a jarred or freezer-stashed sauce instead of building one from scratch when time is short.
Finish with something fresh -- herbs, a squeeze of lime, grated cheese -- to make a shortcut dinner taste intentional.
